notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room 1.8.8 Patch Notes
notes.content: [p]In addition to a variety of bug fixes and improvements, today’s update to Dire Wolf Game Room brings integration for our newest releases, [i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] and [i]Dune: Imperium – Immortality, [/i]allowing players to create and join online games straight from the app. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/cf7561e9f88ba3daf68f4ebdbbb43e69c93aa26c.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]New features:[/h2][list][*][p][i]Ark Nova Digital[/i] game creation integration[/p][/*][*][p][i]Dune: Imperium Digital – Immortality[/i] game creation integration[/p][/*][*][p]Window resizing[/p][/*][*][p]Pip that notifies users of new content[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug fixes:[/h2][list][*][p]Addressed several instances of layout issues[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed instance of text displaying with surrounding squares[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed instance of mislabeled timer options for Munchkin games[/p][/*][*][p]Addressed instances of tiny text in companion apps on mobile[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, if you’re enjoying the Dire Wolf Game Room, please take a moment to leave a review – it’s the best way to help other players discover it! notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room 1.8.7 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Today’s patch addresses a number of bug fixes and improvements, and adds game creation functionality for some of our newer digital releases. 

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Addressed several instances of games not launching correctly
[*] Addressed several instances of games not loading with correct options
[*] Addressed several instances of lobbies not filtering for DLC correctly
[*] Addressed several instances of lobbies displaying properly
[*] Resized and repositioned icons across several games
[*] Addressed text artifact issue appearing on some resolutions
[*] Corrected instance of visual flicker at 1600x900 resolution
[*] Corrected horizontal scrollability for News tiles
[/list]

[h3]Game Creation[/h3]

[list]
[*] Added functionality to launch The Isle of Cats games from Game Room
[*] Added functionality to launch Ark Nova games from Game Room
[*] Updated Clank! launcher with Sunken Treasure options.
[/list]

notes.title: Dune: Imperium – Bloodlines Companion App Hits the Dire Wolf Game Room App!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/70ea3487df249dd85e1cfd9afbe33838fc67d5c9.jpg[/img]

[i]Dune: Imperium – Bloodlines[/i] has landed at your FLGS, and new Sardaukar Commanders are storming the Dire Wolf servers!

This patch brings [i]Dune: Imperium – Bloodlines[/i] to the Dire Wolf Game Room companion app! Enjoy new leaders, fresh House Hagal cards, and streamlined management for your solo and two-player games.

[b]Play as New Leaders![/b] Depending on how you choose to mix and match your Dune: Imperium erxperience, Bloodlines comes with up to 9 new leaders for you to command. These are included in the app for solo, two-player, Arrakeen Scouts, and Blitz play!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/d611bb59488f63bd1f97cb59695ca888be0996cc.gif[/img]

[b]Experience New House Hagal Cards![/b]  With Esmar Tuek adding a whole new board space, and the Tech Module allowing rivals to scoop those Tech Tiles out from under you in your solo games, there are a lot more options in the Hagal deck. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/9ec24a2279aeb6fa9e1f3a2ddb0a73cdc05b25ab.gif[/img]

[b]Let the App Do the Work![/b] With the release of Bloodlines, there are more ways to combine your Dune: Imperium games than ever before. With all of these possible futures in front of you, which Rivals will you select? 

How do you construct the Hagal deck? Easy as calling for a sandworm: just select which expansions you’re using, and the app will show you the “narrow way through.” The app does the heavy lifting for you, including creating the Hagal deck, and displays only the leaders and rivals available for your specific game.  

No matter how you mix and match your games, the [i]Dire Wolf Game Room[/i] companion app is here to help you conquer—or save—Arrakis!

notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room Patch Notes 1.8.5
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/d707f1613f26b69b70deaf4e9c55394d5f810865.jpg[/img]

We’re adding a bit of magic to the Game Room with this patch! Now, Clank! Legacy Acquisitions Incorporated 2: Darkest Magic has full app support to help you build your campaign, grow your franchise, acquire artifacts, and take on the dragon! Adventure awaits!

[h1]Patch Notes[/h1]
[list]
[*] [b]Experience the Book of Secrets Like Never Before![/b] With the full Book of Secrets available in the app, you can listen to each passage, narrated by a complete voice cast, featuring Jerry and Mike from [url=https://www.penny-arcade.com/]Penny Arcade![/url] Simply select any passage by number—no spoilers in the menu!—and dive into the story brought to life. [u]A big thanks to our amazing Kickstarter backers for unlocking this![/u] (Just a heads-up: the narration covers the story text, but you’ll still need to follow the game instructions on each passage yourself.)
[*] [b]Track your Legacy with Mission Reports![/b] The goodies continue with the app’s ability to serve as your Mission Reports document. With this feature, tracking everyone's performance throughout the campaign is easy. You'll enter points as you score them and have the app total it up, identify the winner, and record everything for posterity. Oh yeah, and the Mission Reports screen also links directly to your Prologue and Epilogue passage for each game!
[*] [b]Keep the Adventure Going![/b] The fun doesn’t end when the campaign does! With the app, you'll have a fully playable, self-customized game of [i]Clank Legacy 2.[/i]
[/list]

notes.title: Invincible: The Hero-Building Game companion app!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/5a9e89c58ea6b349cd7b363a3854153c6db6c7d2.png[/img]

Level up your fledgling superhero with the free Dire Wolf Game Room companion app, now including the upcoming [i]Invincible: The Hero-Building Game![/i]

[h1]Tutorial[/h1]
Swoop into action immediately and leave the rulebook behind with the tutorial for the game’s first episode: Short-Staffed in the Hero Department!

Learn to play [i]Invincible: The Hero-Building Game[/i] (now available for pre-order!) with up to 4 players. This tutorial will walk you through how to play, from opening the box and setting the game up, through the details of your first few rounds of the game, and finishing with rules reference tools for your final rounds.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/85814a7d994d4c904b9a6c6fb2d5bbb00d4eb7ab.png[/img]

[h1]Campaign Tracking[/h1]
Chronicle all of the twists-and-turns of Invincible: The Hero-Building Game’s seven episodes in the Campaign Tracker! The app will help you score individual games, track helper cards your team collects, and give you bonus flavor at the end of the campaign.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/4a22afaac0f39012abc0de3a9b015a55a1f4e30c.png[/img]

[h1]Scorepad[/h1]
Looking for a one-off adventure? Use the[b] Score My Game[/b] feature to walk through scoring your performance after you play! How’d you do?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/e66932f0d7c054fd58eecd46b100828db07a7946.png[/img]

[h1]Special Episode: Titan’s Request[/h1]
Titan has seized the reins as the city’s newest crime boss…but Mister Liu’s rival gang isn’t ready to kiss the ring. Gather your team of 1-4 heroes to take on the app-exclusive episode Titan’s Request!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/517e0f88e23d6a443419d22a1f3043c3c06e28ae.png[/img]

The Game Room app provides a unique Episode Card to guide you through the multiple storylines of the adventure as you take down Mister Liu and uncover what Titan is planning behind your back. It never hurts to have friends in low places…but it sometimes hurts to get them!

Free app support is available now in the Dire Wolf Game Room, and [url=https://shop.direwolfdigital.com/products/invincible-the-hero-building-game] Invincible: The Hero-Building Game [/url] is available for pre-order now!

notes.title: An Invincible GRM 1.8.4 Update!
notes.content:
Today’s update brings Invincible: The Hero-Building Game straight into your hands with our new companion app. Learn the ropes in the Tutorial, get some scorekeeping assistance, or try the special Titan episode! And don’t forget, the tabletop game is now available for pre-order.

Patch contents:

Invincible companion app
Bug fixes and optimizations
Upcoming game integration

notes.title: Dire Wolf Game Room Patch Notes 1.8.3
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40744859/a7bbe772c650d24c40a532e0b80dfbdd8f7f028e.jpg[/img]

The latest addition to the Dire Wolf Game Room has gotten sand everywhere!
[b]
*Drum roll please*[/b] [i]Dune: Imperium [/i]is dropping into the Game Room Library, bringing a world of cunning politics, scarce resources, and strategic combat to spice up your game night!

We’ve also addressed a few issues with Root as well as the [i]Clank! Catacombs [/i]and [i]Wild Tiled West [/i]companion apps. 

Happy playing and may your skills be as sharp as a crysknife! 

[h1]Patch details:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Integration and support for Dune Imperium Digital
[*] Addressed a Root softlock when using advanced setup
[*] Bug fixes and improvements for [i]Clank! Catacombs[/i] and [i]Wild Tiled West [/i]companion apps
[/list]
